items.speaker: Liston
items.text: I don’t know of anybody that’s doing that, but I don’t hear Benny Golson’s and Randy – I mean Ernie’s – I don’t hear those things, so I don’t know whether they’re doing that or not.
items.notes: False positive: Liston says "Randy" and immediately corrects herself ("I mean Ernie’s") while naming arrangers whose shadings she has not heard (Benny Golson and, by the correction, presumably Ernie Wilkins). The block is not about Weston; at most a slip of the tongue.
